tools.name: close_and_mint
tools.description: Settlement close that mints the outcome receipt into the agent wallet as a condition of SETTLED. First mint free once per agent; then x402 $0.01 (or wallet plan).

tools.name: mint_receipt
tools.description: Mint an outcome receipt directly. First mint free once per agent; then x402 $0.01 (or wallet plan).

tools.name: aggregate_proof
tools.description: Registry-signed aggregate proof over an agent's history (counts/dispute rate, no receipts surrendered). x402 $0.05 per 1,000 receipts in the set.

tools.name: verify_receipts
tools.description: Completeness check of a surrendered receipt list vs registry ground truth. Free.

tools.name: check_tx
tools.description: MINTED or NEVER_MINTED for a transaction id. Free.

tools.name: export_wallet
tools.description: Export your agent's wallet as JSON.
